notes.title: The long-awaited Release!
notes.notes: We are happy to announce that the game is now available in the store! I hope you enjoy it. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The demo version of the game is available now!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the demo version of Dreamless is out. The game includes one of the main acts of the full version of the game. Approximate playthrough time is ~20 minutes.
